document.abstract: SMPTE members will be saddened to learn of the passing of John H. Battison on 28 August, 2012 at his home in Loudonville, Ohio, just a few days before his 97th birthday. Battison was known to many in the television broadcast community and was instrumental in launching the Society of Broadcast Engineers professional organization in 1964.
